scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Your base level is too low, come back when you hit level 60+.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
您的基礎等級太低了，請達到60級後再來。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
^ff0000If you attempt to tame any monsters, it will not count as a kill. Please be careful.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
^ff0000如果您嘗試馴服魔物，將不會被計為擊殺。請小心。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Oh, a curious onlooker? I'm Marry Jae, the person in charge of weekends among the days of the week.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
哦，一位好奇的旁觀者？我是瑪麗·傑，負責一週中週末事務的人。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
What is the weekend dungeon? Actually, it's a specially designed space for new adventurers to train.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
什麼是週末地下城？其實，它是專為新冒險者訓練而設計的空間。

scripts.text: ^0000FFLooking around, it's obvious that Marry Jae is talking to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF環顧四周，很明顯瑪麗·傑正在和你說話。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
For those who do not have a party on the weekends, this place is hunting and experience gaining grounds for lonely adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
對於週末沒有隊伍的人來說，這裡是孤獨冒險者的狩獵和獲取經驗的地方！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Besides, the experience gain here is very generous.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
而且，這裡的經驗值獲取非常豐厚。

scripts.text: When is the opening time?
scripts.translation: 開放時間是什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The dungeon will be open during:
^0000FFSaturday 00:00 ~ Sunday 23:59^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
地下城將在以下時間開放：
^0000FF週六 00:00 ~ 週日 23:59^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
I hope to see you when the weekend arrives~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
期待週末與您相見~

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You need to form a party of one member or more.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
您需要組建一個至少包含一名成員的隊伍。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Sorry, but the entry period to the {0} has expired.
Take a rest while waiting for the dungeon to be available again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
抱歉，進入{0}的期限已過。
請休息片刻，等待地下城再次開放。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The cooldown has expired.
You may re-enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
緊急冷卻已結束。
您可以重新進入記憶地下城。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
I think you're just about ready.
Now, would you like to enter it now?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
我想您已經準備好了。
那麼，您現在要進入嗎？

scripts.text: Enter Weekend Dungeon
scripts.translation: 進入週末地下城

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The Memorial Dungeon has been created.
You may now enter.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
記憶地下城已建立。
您現在可以進入了。

scripts.text: There is no Memorial Dungeon registered.
scripts.translation: 沒有註冊的記憶地下城。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You have not prepared?
Can't really help it I guess.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
您還沒有準備好嗎？
那我也沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
I offer packaging services for those who wish to present a precious gift to a cherished one.
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
我為那些想向珍視之人贈送珍貴禮物的人提供包裝服務。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
If you have 5 units of <ITEM>{0}<INFO>23143</INFO></ITEM> or <ITEM>{1}<INFO>23142</INFO></ITEM>, I can pack it for just ^FF0000{2}^000000 Zeny!
Do you want to pack it right now?
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
如果您有5個<ITEM>{0}<INFO>23143</INFO></ITEM>或<ITEM>{1}<INFO>23142</INFO></ITEM>，我只需^FF0000{2}^000000 Zeny就能為您包裝！
您現在要包裝嗎？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Growth Elixir Packing
scripts.translation: 成長靈藥包裝

scripts.text: Job Elixir Packing
scripts.translation: 職業靈藥包裝

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Come back whenever you need packaging services!
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
需要包裝服務時，隨時歡迎回來！

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Please come back when you have enough materials.
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
請準備好足夠的材料後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Please come back when you have enough Zeny.
{0}z to be specific.
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
請準備好足夠的Zeny後再回來。
具體需要{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
You have too many kinds of objects. Clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
您的物品種類太多了。請清理一下背包。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Can't continue because you have too many heavy objects. Reduce your total weight by clearing your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
由於您攜帶的重型物品過多，無法繼續。請清理背包以減輕總重量。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Confirm to spend {0}z to package 5 <ITEM>{1}<INFO>{2}</INFO></ITEM> into <ITEM>{3}<INFO>{4}</INFO></ITEM>?
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
確認花費{0} Zeny，將5個<ITEM>{1}<INFO>{2}</INFO></ITEM>包裝成<ITEM>{3}<INFO>{4}</INFO></ITEM>嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Come back whenever you need packaging services!
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
需要包裝服務時，隨時歡迎回來！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Before we start setting up the environment here, we'll give you the chance to choose an appropriate difficulty level.
I could make my own choice, but each person handles it differently based on their abilities.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
在開始佈置這裡的環境之前，我會給您選擇合適難度的機會。
雖然我可以替您做決定，但每個人根據自己的能力會有不同的處理方式。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Your base level is too low to select this, you need to be level {0} + .
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
您的基礎等級太低，無法選擇此項，需要達到{0}級或以上。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Good luck finding the treasures!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
祝您尋寶順利！
